description: Raw cloud-proxy operations for a client's cloud-browser profile: rotate (fresh IP, same region), relocate (new country/region), or disable. BAMF platform admin only; never agency-scoped. These change the client's apparent location to LinkedIn, so prefer bamf.ensure_proxy. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan and risk warning only; call again with confirm=true only after the operator approves. Reports 'not available yet' until the cloud browser engine supports it.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name.

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true applies it.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Required for relocate.

name: bamf.manage_proxy
